Home / History / The queue

The version-6 queue as a support team saw it, read from the four recorded version-6 runs, in English.

Today's disputes

Tribunal decides one disputed trip from one evidence brief: two AI advocates argue the same brief, a citation referee checks every claim, a judge answers four times and its majority decides, and a person decides what the panel cannot.

Every dispute shown here is a synthetic test case, except case 901, which is the organisers' sample. These figures are development data. These pages replay the recorded runs committed in this repository and call no model; every number is read from the run's own files. How the figures were measured.

See case 208How it works

  3. 3The citation refereechecks every claim against the record→
  4. 4The judge, four draftsAI; a majority carries the ruling→
  5. 5A ruling, or a personthe money held until a person decides

Safeguards

  • Cited or dropped. Every claim must name evidence and a clause that exist in the record; the citation referee drops any claim that does not.
  • A person for what the panel cannot decide. 26 of 151 queued disputes went to a reviewer, with no ruling issued and the amount held.
  • Safety goes straight to a person. A safety or complaint flag stops the case before any model is asked (case 2735: 0 model calls).
  • A planted clause is not obeyed. In case 1779 the record carries a planted clause; all four drafts refused it, and the code check voided them, so a person decides.
  • One appeal. Either party may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04); a different human reviewer hears it.
  • Privacy. Vehicle registration marks, telephone numbers and e-mail addresses are masked before a model reads the record; names are not.
  • What it does not do. Every case shown except 901 is synthetic, and the limits are listed in full.

Accessibility: light and dark themes, tables that sort and scroll from the keyboard, and text contrast of at least 4.5:1, recomputed by the test suite. An axe-core 4.8.2 scan of the live site on 2026-10-12 found no violations.
